title: Blood and Cystic Fluid From Patients Undergoing Surgery for Worrisome Pancreatic Cysts
official: Pilot Proof of Concept Study of miRNA and Protein Signatures in Exosomes From Blood and Cystic Fluid in Patients Undergoing Surgery for Worrisome Pancreatic Cysts
summary: The goal of this study is to collect biospecimens (blood and cystic fluid) and data from participants who have a pancreatic cyst that requires surgical resection. The blood and fluid samples will be analyzed for research into DNA, RNA, and proteins.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Voluntarily agree to participate by giving written informed consent prior to any study-specific procedures.
* Subject at least 18 years of age and able to provide consent. Subject is willing and able to comply with requirements of the protocol.
* Radiologically documented cyst of the pancreas for which surgical removal is clinically indicated.
* Patient will be undergoing a surgical resection of their pancreatic cystic neoplasm.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient who is pregnant at the time of study enrollment and sample collection.
* Patient will not be undergoing clinically indicated surgery for a pancreatic cystic neoplasm.
* Patient is unwilling or unable to provide informed consent or comply with study procedures.
